abstract: Maintains hydraulic pressure integrity assessments and corridor operating duration logs
system_message:
You are the Hydraulic engineering lead (HYD), responsible for maintaining hydraulic pressure integrity assessments, corridor operating duration logs, and surge arrestor transient dampening data across active water supply corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains hydraulic pressure integrity assessments and corridor operating duration logs（PRESS）
information_points.content:
HYD-PRESS-38J：For the Highland gravity trunkline, hydrostatic testing confirmed that active delivery trunkline sections maintained hydraulic pressure integrity, sustaining working pressure without loss. The corridor operating duration is scheduled for 10 h of active pumping on the activation day.
HYD-PRESS-Q8I：For the Overland modular hose corridor, hydrostatic pressure logs show that active delivery sections failed to maintain hydraulic pressure integrity during pre-commissioning. The corridor operating duration is logged at 8 h of active pumping for the planned activation day.
HYD-PRESS-E3U：Hydrostatic pipe pressure test logs verify that active trunkline sections of the Riverbed booster pipeline satisfied hydraulic pressure integrity by holding working pressure without loss. Its corridor operating duration is scheduled for 10 h of active pumping on the activation day.

information_points.title: Surge arrestor dampening（SURGE）
information_points.content:
HYD-SURGE-WOK：Hydraulic transient test logs for the Highland gravity trunkline record a surge arrestor dampening duration of 25 s to dampen pressure oscillations at corridor shutoff valves after closure.
HYD-SURGE-BZ8：Transient testing logs indicate a surge arrestor dampening duration of 15 s across the shutoff valves for the Overland modular hose corridor.
HYD-SURGE-CDM：At the corridor shutoff valves of the Riverbed booster pipeline, the surge arrestor dampening duration measured during transient testing is 20 s.
